precautions.COVID-19: Isolate, monitor oxygen levels, consult a doctor if breathless.
precautions.Malaria: Consult a doctor for a blood test; avoid mosquito exposure.
precautions.Typhoid: Consult a doctor; maintain hydration and hygiene.
precautions.Dengue: Consult a doctor immediately; avoid aspirin/NSAIDs.
precautions.Migraine: Rest in a dark room; avoid triggers; consult a doctor if frequent.
precautions.Allergy: Avoid the allergen; antihistamines if advised by a doctor.
precautions.Pneumonia: Seek medical attention promptly; monitor breathing.
precautions.Flu / Influenza: Rest, fluids, consult a doctor if symptoms worsen.
